method: Targeted web search constrained to each journal's official publisher domain, followed by title and abstract review on stable publisher pages.
scope_limit: This is a dated, targeted search. It is not a systematic review, does not prove absence, and does not establish priority for the broader young-worker or public-CPS pattern.
exact_design_definition: A peer-reviewed article combining a national monthly CPS young-versus-older employment-stock design with systematic within-design variation across named occupational AI-exposure architectures and mapping/support constructions.
